claim.statement: The pinned local DINOv3 checkpoint can feed a bounded embedding caller that decodes exactly four verified embedding roles, constructs the existing CPU embedding boundary, and keeps transformer block weights unloaded.
claim.scope: Real local role loading plus synthetic bounded forward composition; the real 1024-wide model forward remains guarded and unclaimed.

evidence.result: 3 examples, 0 failures; bounded synthetic forward, aggregate budget rejection, and immutable four-role registry
fails before role decode with temporary-residency budget error
manifest SHA-256 mismatch before caller construction

dod: The real pinned artifact loads only the four embedding roles and reports 3,170,304 parameter bytes.
The bounded caller forwards a small synthetic parameter set through the existing CPU embedding API.
Aggregate temporary residency and digest mismatch fail closed before model-scale allocation or execution.
CPU-only DINOv3/TRELLIS.2 suites, no-codegen builds, formatting, and diff checks pass.

excluded: 24 transformer blocks and final norm weights
same-size replacement races after digest receipt

residual_risks: The real checkpoint remains a user-local artifact and is intentionally not committed.
The caller's real model forward is not executed because the existing multiply-add guard rejects model-scale 1024-wide 512/1024 projection.
The digest receipt is not a file lock; callers must prevent same-size replacement during role decode.
The embedding parameter arrays retain owned decoded values and are single-owner/non-concurrent by contract.
